_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Housekeeping: removed unused backup-sentence loading code from the card script; the changelog now keeps the latest 30 entries.
detail: Removed the never-called backup example loader from flashcards.js (no visible change).
Trimmed this changelog to the newest 30 entries; older ones stay in git history.
Deploy merges now keep at most 30 entries, so trimmed entries cannot return.

entries.summary: Main menu tidy: even header spacing, 'Practice errors' section, no app name in copy
detail: Less space above Choose level and Choose a set, so each title sits evenly between the box above and its own box
Choose a set no longer says 'Level 1 · 1/4 sets studied'; the set buttons already show it

Practice is now a 'Practice errors' section with the same header and info button as the others ('Words you have not got right come first.'); it reads 'N cards ready to practise' and 'Quick practice (20)', with no explainer text
The Practice sheet drops its top block and holds spaced repetition and the three practice groups; 'Not right yet' is now 'Never correct' and 'very late' is 'long overdue another review'
'Fluency' is replaced with 'this app' (or reworded) in visible text across the app; the Spotify player's device name is unchanged

entries.summary: Use a richer Portuguese tutorial card and make practice instructions explicit
detail: Replace banco with provar: prove, taste and try on, with 14 curated release examples
Keep the dominant meaning first and preserve verified IMDb and Tatoeba sources
Replace button-like Try it labels with instructions naming the card control to click or tap
Highlight the whole example sentence when explaining example cycling
Reveal closed meaning groups when the next explanation needs their rows and fit mobile cards to the instruction sheet

entries.summary: Search and word links open a split word as Flashcard 1 of 2, then 2 of 2
detail: Search, word links, lyric-breakdown taps and homograph peeks used to open a split word (vamos, hay) as one combined card; they now open Flashcard 1 of 2
Moving on from it (swipe, flag or next) shows Flashcard 2 of 2 in the same place before returning; the Back-to button still leaves at once
When search focuses a particular meaning, the card that holds it opens first
Split cards are built by one shared function (buildSplitCardPair) for sets and single-word views alike

entries.summary: Remove the incorrect entity-style icon beside banco in the tutorial
detail: Remove the dictionary icon added beside the Portuguese tutorial headword
Remove its extra explanation and unused header styling
Keep the verified example-source labels below the example sentence

entries.summary: Explain part of speech and dictionary form separately in the tutorial
detail: Give the part-of-speech label and dictionary form their own explanation boxes
Highlight each part of the front-card pill separately while stepping through the tutorial

entries.summary: Commonness is the share of the senses shown; grouped senses carry one meter under the gloss; 'N rarer senses' row
detail: Commonness labels and percentages are read against the senses a learner can see: expressions (their own card) leave the base, rarer senses stay in it
Split cards read their shares against their own reading, not the sibling card's senses
A grouped sense whose sub-rows share one commonness shows its meter under the gloss; the side column goes and sub-rows get the width
A lone sense that is not Dominant gets an 'N rarer senses' row with their combined commonness; it opens Rarer uses

entries.summary: Polish the Portuguese card tutorial for desktop
detail: Make Next larger with a stronger amber reminder highlight
Give desktop cards more height while retaining compact mobile fitting
Order meanings by commonness and remove the old selection tick
Add working meaning information and complete dictionary/source highlights
Show verified IMDb titles for Portuguese dialogue examples

entries.summary: Import known words is available for every language
detail: Enable import in Settings, progress and placement for all signed-in learners
Match against the selected language’s Speech deck and save its language and card IDs
Accept current surface card IDs and preserve exact accents, preview and repeat-import behaviour

entries.summary: Refresh the desktop shortcut guide and full keyboard reference
detail: Six essential study shortcuts in a compact panel with flat, theme-aware key badges
Hide and reopen controls remember the existing preference; All shortcuts opens the full reference
Shared shortcut definitions show accurate Mac/Windows labels and eligible audit tools
Keyboard focus works on guide controls; existing study keys and reference-only rows are preserved
Guide adapts to smaller windows and larger text and returns after a docked panel closes

entries.summary: Senses fold their sub-rows when they would need scrolling; Rarer uses is rare senses only; bigger gear tap area
detail: When two or more senses would scroll, grouped senses fold to their main row with a '+N' chip that opens them; other senses fold before the current one, and a lone sense never folds
Rarer uses no longer lists expressions (they have their own card after a correct answer)
Back-of-card gear: tap area 52px wide (was 44)
Roadmap: TERSE row for shortening long Wiktionary contexts (e.g. pt não)

entries.summary: Split-card note under the POS pills; info buttons outside shaded sub-rows; colour fixes; reinforcement follows the review queue
detail: 'Flashcard 1 of 2' sits directly under the lemma/POS pills, no underline; the other reading is greyed more clearly
'POS from x' pairs get their capsule back so the lemma reads as belonging to its pill; bare POS pills stay plain
Info buttons on grouped sub-rows now sit outside the shaded context area, as on single-sense rows
Rarer uses: example borders take the POS colour (a hard-coded teal overrode it); expression examples use the phrase purple, like the scrubber's phrase pip
Back of card: gear icon 28px; scrubber track no longer leaves a wide gap before the gear
Example reinforcement ranks sentences by words due in the review queue instead of words missed in the last 7 days

entries.summary: Fix split cards crashing mid-render (the real 'third card')
detail: Split cards called an undefined colour function (posAccentRgb), so rendering stopped after the 'Flashcard 1 of 2' label and the previous card's word, POS, rank and frequency stayed on screen
Now uses getPosAccentRgb; vamos and hay each render as exactly two full cards with the word's full rank and frequency

entries.summary: Split words show only Flashcard 1 of 2 and 2 of 2; lighter front POS labels
detail: No phrase follow-up card after a split companion card (it read as a third card)
Any other card for the same surface is dropped when the surface is split; replaces the lemma-based filter, which could drop unrelated words
'Card 1 of 2' is now plain 'Flashcard 1 of 2' text, larger, with a tap-for-explanation tooltip
Front lemma/POS labels lose the capsule behind them and grow ~10%

entries.summary: Fix 3rd card in split-card sets and balance POS-only pill padding.
detail: Deduplicated study sets so polysemous/homograph split cards suppress redundant base/infinitive cards covering the same readings, ensuring only Card 1 of 2 and Card 2 of 2 are presented without an extra 3rd card.
Balanced horizontal padding and centering on .front-lemma-pair.is-pos-only so standalone POS pills are perfectly symmetric.

entries.summary: The first visit after an update now reads the new config, not the previous one.
detail: The service worker served config files from its cache, so new app code could run against the old release list until a second reload (seen with Czech loading v21 after v22 shipped).
Config files are now fetched from the network first; the cached copy is used only when offline.

entries.summary: Czech speech deck updated to v22: fixed verbal expressions are now recognised.
detail: About 730 Czech examples now show the expression they belong to, e.g. dávat pozor, v pohodě, ve skutečnosti, mít rád, dát vědět.
Everything else in the Czech deck is unchanged from v21.

entries.summary: French card-back conjugation tables now come from Wiktionary as well.
detail: The French Conjugate drawer reads a Wiktionary table (32 verbs, up from 29 from verbecc) published with release fr-speech-v7-dual-metadata-v6-20261004; the French deck itself is unchanged.
Jehle and verbecc are no longer used anywhere: their source code and pin commands are removed.

entries.summary: Resuming a Speech session or opening a word link no longer waits for the conjugation tables.
detail: The Wiktionary tables are 250-330 KB compressed; they now load in the background on every route, as they already did after choosing a language.
The first card may show an uninflected English gloss ("to have") for a moment, then switches to "I have" when the tables arrive.

entries.summary: Deployed learner-align/v1 cognate similarity scorer and owner audit diagnostics.
detail: Replaced stop-gap edit-distance/v1 with pluggable learner-align/v1 across all cognate policies (es, pt, cs, fr, nl, fi).

Learner-align/v1 recovers previously missed phonetic and morphological cognates (e.g. capitán/captain, número/number, eternidad/eternity, que/what) while strictly rejecting deceptive short look-alikes.
Added cognate algorithm and scorer inspection to owner/admin tools in Settings Developer tab, Fast Track technical details, and Card Data (⌘I) provenance panel.

entries.summary: Fixed decks failing to load with "items.some is not a function".
detail: The sense-prominence check read each meaning's metadata as a list, but releases store it as an object, so some sets stopped loading.
It now reads the features inside the object and only counts a construction difference when a sibling sense lacks it.

entries.summary: About page now credits Wiktionary for conjugations.
detail: The sources line read "Spanish conjugations from Jehle"; every conjugation table now comes from Wiktionary, so it reads "conjugations from Wiktionary".

entries.summary: Spanish and Portuguese decks now tell reflexive verbs apart (hacer vs hacerse), and all conjugations come from Wiktionary.
detail: New v23 speech decks for Spanish and Portuguese. On verbs with both a plain and a reflexive meaning, each example is checked for a reflexive pronoun that belongs to the verb (te vas a sentar, siéntate, virou-se) before a meaning is picked.

About 9,400 Spanish and 1,300 Portuguese examples changed meaning family, e.g. ¿No vas a sentarte? now shows sentarse and Me voy a casar shows casarse. Unclear cases (a 3rd-person se that may be passive) keep the previous choice.

Verb drills and card-back conjugation tables are rebuilt from Wiktionary: Spanish goes from 434 to 1,783 verbs (including reflexive verbs such as acostarse and compound tenses), Portuguese from 955 to 1,420 verbs with the pluperfect added.
Fixes the broken Portuguese 'nós' preterites in the drill (dan -> dançámos, ris) -> riscámos).
Spanish card backs now include the imperative and future subjunctive.
Verb-drill progress starts fresh (storage keys v2) because the Spanish tense names changed.

entries.summary: Verb drills can start with the verbs you got wrong in your vocabulary flashcards this week.
detail: New Set up switch under Progress, on by default: "Start with verbs from your flashcard mistakes".
Reads flashcard misses from the last 7 days (signed in, this device) and matches them to any form or infinitive in the drill.
Words the vocabulary treats as non-verbs (casa, para, entre) no longer pull a look-alike verb forward; lists built by scripts/build_conjugation_not_verbs.py for es, pt and cs.
A line under the switch says how many verbs will come first.

entries.summary: Polished split card and POS pill UX: POS-colored highlights, scrubber 7A/7B, and removed redundant badges.
detail: Hidden lemma text on front POS pills when the lemma is identical to the surface word, keeping only clean POS badges.
Ensured split card pills strictly mirror card order (Card 1 pill on left, Card 2 pill on right).
Adopted dynamic POS-accent coloring for active split pill highlighting and the front 'Card 1 of 2' note.
Removed internal 1/2 and 2/2 tags from pills and removed 'Card 2 of 2' badge from the back of the card.
Updated set scrubber to label split companion cards with letter suffixes (e.g. 7A, 7B).

entries.summary: Deterministic dictionary-attested pronominal card splitting across languages.
detail: Replaced hardcoded RADICAL_REFLEXIVE_ROOTS whitelist with deterministic root pairing between base and attested pronominal headwords.
Automatically enables split companion cards for verbs with distinct pronominal semantics (e.g. hacer/hacerse, fazer/fazer-se) without manual lists.
Preserved Class 1 homograph and Class 2 reflexive parity across Python and JavaScript runtimes with complete test coverage.

entries.summary: Streamlined polysemous split cards: clean 'from [lemma]' pills, concise 'Card 1 of 2' labels, and removed back redundancy.
detail: Prefixed lemmas differing from card surface form with a clean 'from ' label in front POS pills, avoiding confusing linguistic jargon.
Simplified split card note to 'Card 1 of 2' and labeled active vs companion pill capsules with '1/2' and '2/2'.
Unified all badges and tags to standard reading typography (--font-reading) without monospaced fonts.
Removed redundant companion footer box on card back, keeping a single clean header badge.

entries.summary: French and Portuguese Artist decks: fixed filtering by selected songs.
detail: Built complete per-song card membership from all frozen lyric occurrences, rather than sampled examples.
Verified native profile summaries and preserved nine existing public release trees, including Spanish artists.
Updated catalog to the final French and Portuguese releases.

entries.summary: Artist mode: added reviewed French and Portuguese test decks.
detail: French Test Playlist: 64 songs and 2,097 cards; Portuguese Test Playlist: 19 songs and 869 cards.
Added language adapters, reviewed morphology and phrase menus, native WSD provenance, and complete source/span validation.
Artist colours inherit language defaults when a release supplies no bespoke theme.
Existing Spanish artists and the older French playlist remain available. Sentence translations are explicitly unavailable.

entries.summary: Cards: streamlined split card presentation — reused existing front lemma-POS pills tagged by card, removed clutter/emojis, and added a concise explanatory note.
detail: Front lemma-POS integration: reused existing header pills for both readings with Card 1 and Card 2 tags, highlighting the active card and muting the companion.
Concise split note: replaced bulky banners with a clean note: 'This word has distinct meanings and is split across 2 cards.'
Streamlined frequency: removed redundant percentage breakdowns from the frequency button, preserving clean standard frequency presentation.
Emoji removal: removed emojis from the back companion cue and simplified companion text.
